title: Aagneyam
desc: Young and pure of heart, Madhavan is adored by every single one of his villagers. However, a false accusation of two murders alters the course of his life.

desc: A man proposes to his close friend on the night before her wedding. However, he incurs the wrath of her older brothers when he elopes with her.

desc: Gopinadhan and Mathunni steal money from the rich and distribute it amongst the needy. When Mathunni robs Maya, Gopinadhan returns it and falls in love with her.

desc: Following the death of his ex-wife, a retired police officer, who is known for his investigative prowess, unexpectedly gets pulled into a criminal case involving organ harvesting.

title: Ayitham
desc: Bhama falls in love with Shankaran, but she is forced to marry another man. However, her life takes a turn when she discovers that her husband is already married.

title: Gauthamante Radham
desc: Gauthaman's joy is palpable after securing his driving licence, as he dreams of driving the very first car his family has ever possessed.

title: Vishnulokam
desc: Circus performer Sankunni's heart is captured by village belle, Savithrikutty. However, this romantic pursuit is complicated by a rival's sinister intentions, testing Sankunni's resolve and talents.
